research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: X-ZELL is researching systems and methods for identifying and classifying rare cells, as described in Machine learning systems and methods for identifying and classifying rare cells, which utilizes machine learning to analyze biological samples. Devices and methods for rapid channel-by-channel fluorescence microscopy focus on rapid imaging of samples, while Systems and methods for identifying rare cells detail techniques for fixing, staining, and identifying circulating tumor cells. These efforts target same-day cancer diagnostics from minimally invasive samples.

We develop innovative laboratory solutions that enable same-day cancer diagnoses from minimally invasive sample material – we call it next-generation cytology (NGC).

product.name: Cryoimmunostaining™ Suite
product.description: A two-instrument slide staining system for liquid samples that operates at sub-zero temperatures to preserve sample integrity and enable immunostaining without cytoblocking.

product.name: Cryofixator™
product.description: An instrument that performs direct-to-slide fixation of liquid biopsy samples at sub-zero temperatures, eliminating the need for cytoblocking and preserving cellular details.

product.name: Cryostainer™
product.description: A slide-based immunofluorescence staining system that applies multiplex antibody panels to a single slide, enabling simultaneous detection of multiple markers.

product.name: Hybrid Microscope
product.description: A proprietary microscopy workstation that allows real-time side-by-side evaluation and digital visualization of multiple fluorescence channels on cytology slides.

product.name: hMX™ Cell Separation System
product.description: A patented system that gently removes leukocytes from whole blood to isolate single atypical cells for downstream analysis.
